title: Routing Beyond Task Categories: A Cost-Aware LAB-Bench Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.20732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We tested whether features of biology questions or of a model's first answer can improve accuracy within an inference budget. In a LAB-Bench pilot, we compared a category router with one that adds six structural features. Neither reached the primary 80% accuracy target on development. At the 50% and 60% secondary targets, both chose Haiku for all 120 held-out questions and scored 71/120. We then froze a new comparison before collecting responses on 144 additional questions. Semantic routing scored 86/144. A policy that could defer after reading Haiku's answer scored 87/144. Both stayed within the inference budget of USD 0.678 per 1,000 queries. Against a 95% Haiku and 5% GPT mixture, the accuracy gains were 0.66 percentage points for semantic routing and 1.35 points for deferral. The paired 95% intervals were [-0.28,2.25] and [-0.14,3.47] points. A simple rule that escalated Haiku nonanswers scored 92/144 at USD 0.710 per 1,000 queries,

translated_title: 超越任务类别的路由：一项成本感知的LAB-Bench研究
translated_abstract: 我们测试了生物学问题的特征或模型首次回答的特征能否在推理预算内提高准确性。在LAB-Bench试点中，我们比较了仅基于任务类别的路由器与增加了六个结构特征的路由器，两者在开发集上均未达到80%的主要准确率目标。在50%和60%的次要目标下，两者均对所有120个保留问题选择了Haiku模型，得分为71/120。随后，我们在收集另外144个问题的回答之前预先冻结了一个新的比较方案：语义路由得分为86/144；一种可以在读取Haiku的回答后再决定是否延迟改用更强模型的策略得分为87/144。两者均保持在每1000次查询0.678美元的推理预算之内。与95% Haiku加5% GPT的混合基线相比，语义路由的准确率提升为0.66个百分点，延迟策略为1.35个百分点，配对95%置信区间分别为[-0.28, 2.25]和[-0.14, 3.47]个百分点。此外，一条将Haiku未作答情况升级处理的简单规则得分为92/144，成本为每1000次查询0.710美元。
tldr: 该研究发现在固定推理预算内，基于语义特征的路由和延迟决策策略相比简单的模型混合仅带来小幅且统计不显著的准确率提升，而将模型未作答情况升级处理的简单规则表现最佳。
en_tdlr: Within a fixed inference budget, semantic routing and deferral strategies yield only small and statistically insignificant accuracy gains over simple model mixtures, while a simple rule that escalates model nonanswers performs best.
